task.title: Unbox Your Pulse Bottle
task.shortdesc: Confirm you have all parts before setting up your Pulse bottle.

context.p: Your Pulse box contains the bottle, a USB-C charging cable, and a quick start card.

step.cmd: Remove the bottle, charging cable, and quick start card from the box.
Peel the protective film from the touch display on the cap.
Check that the rubber seal is seated correctly inside the cap.

taskbody.result: Your Pulse bottle is ready to charge.
